## Load data
```{r load-agg-data, include=FALSE}
df <- read_parquet("data/metrics/processed/clean-dl-training-energy-consumption-dataset.gzip") %>%
    rename(
        energy = `energy (MJ)`,
        power_draw = `average gpu power (W)`,
        batch_size = `batch size`,
        image_size = `image size`,
        allocated_ram = `total ram (GB)`,
        training_environment = `training environment`,
    ) %>%
    mutate(
        energy_per_image = (energy * 1000000) / `total seen images`, # Convert MJ to J and normalize by total seen images
        epoch_duration = `training duration (h)` / `trained epochs` * 3600, # Calculate average epoch duration in seconds
        batch_size = factor(batch_size, levels = c("32", "64", "256")),
        input_size = factor(image_size, levels = c("(75, 75)", "(128, 128)", "(224, 224)")),
        dataset = factor(dataset),
        dataset = case_match(
            dataset,
            "stanford_dogs" ~ "Stanford Dogs",
            "caltech101" ~ "Caltech 101"
        ),
        training_environment = factor(training_environment, levels = c("Desktop Normal User", "Desktop ML Engineer", "Server")),
    ) %>%
    select(run_id, energy_per_image, power_draw, epoch_duration, batch_size, input_size, dataset, training_environment, allocated_ram)
```
```{r load-data-energy-regimes}
regimes_df <- read_parquet("data/analysis/processed/regimes.gzip")

regimes_df <- regimes_df %>%
    rename(
        stabilizing_epoch = `stabilizing epoch`,
    ) %>%
    inner_join(df %>% select(run_id, training_environment), by = "run_id")

regimes_df
```

### Plot the cumulative distribution of stabilizing epochs for each training environment
```{r plot-cumulative-distribution, echo=FALSE, fig.width=10, fig.height=2.75}
# Prepare data for ECDF lines
all_ecdf <- regimes_df %>%
    count(stabilizing_epoch) %>%
    arrange(stabilizing_epoch) %>%
    mutate(cum_pct = cumsum(n) / sum(n))

env_ecdf <- regimes_df %>%
    group_by(training_environment, stabilizing_epoch) %>%
    tally() %>%
    arrange(training_environment, stabilizing_epoch) %>%
    group_by(training_environment) %>%
    mutate(cum_pct = cumsum(n) / sum(n))

cumm_plot <- ggplot() +
    # Per-environment ECDFs
    geom_line(
        data = env_ecdf,
        aes(x = stabilizing_epoch, y = cum_pct, color = training_environment, linetype = "Environment"),
        linewidth = 1
    ) +
    # All ECDF
    geom_line(
        data = all_ecdf,
        aes(x = stabilizing_epoch, y = cum_pct, color = "All", linetype = "All"),
        linewidth = 1
    ) +
    # 90% line
    geom_hline(
        aes(yintercept = 0.9, color = "90%", linetype = "90%"),
        linewidth = 1
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
        name = NULL,
        values = c(
            "Desktop Normal User" = "#21908CFF",
            "Desktop ML Engineer" = "#440154",
            "Server" = "#FDE725FF",
            "All" = "orange",
            "90%" = "black"
        ),
        breaks = c("Desktop Normal User", "Desktop ML Engineer", "Server", "All", "90%"),
        labels = c("Desktop Normal User", "Desktop ML Engineer", "Server", "All", "90%")
    ) +
    scale_linetype_manual(
        name = NULL,
        values = c(
            "Environment" = "solid",
            "All" = "dashed",
            "90%" = "dashed"
        ),
        breaks = c("Environment", "All", "90%"),
        labels = c("Environment", "All", "90%")
    ) +
    labs(
        x = "Stabilizing epoch",
        y = "Cumulative percentage of\ntraining executions"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, max(regimes_df$stabilizing_epoch), by = 10)) +
    guides(
        color = guide_legend(
            override.aes = list(linetype = c("solid", "solid", "solid", "dashed", "dashed")),
            ncol = 1
        ),
        linetype = "none"
    ) +
    theme(
        legend.position = "inside",
        legend.justification = c("right", "bottom"),
        legend.box.just = "left",
        legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
        legend.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent"),
    )

cumm_plot

ggsave(
    plot = cumm_plot + pub_theme,
    filename = file.path(fig_dir, "stabilizing-epoch-cumulative-distribution.pdf"),
    device = cairo_pdf,
    units = "cm",
    width = 13.71, height = 5, dpi = 300
)
```

## Compute the RMSE for each training environment
```{r compute-rmse-by-window-size}
rmse_df <- energy_estimation_data %>%
    group_by(`window size`) %>%
    summarise(
        rmse_method_1 = sqrt(mean((`estimated total energy (kJ) (STEP-P)` - `total energy (kJ)`)^2)),
        rmse_method_2 = sqrt(mean((`estimated total energy (kJ) (STEP-E)` - `total energy (kJ)`)^2)),
        .groups = "drop"
    )

rmse_window_plot <- ggplot(rmse_df, aes(x = `window size`)) +
    geom_line(aes(y = rmse_method_1, color = "STEP-P"), linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_line(aes(y = rmse_method_2, color = "STEP-E"), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5) +
    labs(
        x = "Window size (epochs)",
        y = "RMSE (kJ)",
        title = "RMSE of energy estimation vs. window size"
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
        name = NULL,
        values = c("STEP-P" = "#440154FF", "STEP-E" = "#21908CFF")
    )

rmse_window_plot
```

```{r compute-rmse-by-epoch}
rmse_df <- energy_estimation_by_epoch_start %>%
    group_by(`stabilizing epoch`) %>%
    summarise(
        rmse_method_1 = sqrt(mean((`estimated energy (kJ) (STEP-P)` - `total energy (kJ)`)^2)),
        rmse_method_2 = sqrt(mean((`estimated energy (kJ) (STEP-E)` - `total energy (kJ)`)^2)),
        .groups = "drop"
    )

rmse_epoch_plot <- ggplot(rmse_df, aes(x = `stabilizing epoch`)) +
    geom_line(aes(y = rmse_method_1, color = "STEP-P"), linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_line(aes(y = rmse_method_2, color = "STEP-E"), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5) +
    labs(
        x = "Stabilizing epoch",
        y = "RMSE (kJ)",
        title = "RMSE of energy estimation vs. stabilizing epoch"
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
        name = NULL,
        values = c("STEP-P" = "#440154FF", "STEP-E" = "#21908CFF")
    )

rmse_epoch_plot
```

## Plot energy estimation comparison by estimation method
```{r load-data-energy-estimation-comparison, echo=FALSE}
energy_estimation_comparison <- read_parquet("data/analysis/processed/energy-estimation-results.gzip")
```

Error metrics on the held-out test configurations. `R2` is the coefficient of determination (1 - SSE/SST), which penalizes bias; `r2` is the squared Pearson correlation, which does not; `bias` is the mean signed error (kJ).
```{r energy-estimation-metrics}
estimation_metrics <- function(true, pred) {
    errors <- pred - true
    c(
        RMSE = sqrt(mean(errors^2)),
        MAE = mean(abs(errors)),
        R2 = 1 - sum(errors^2) / sum((true - mean(true))^2),
        r2 = cor(true, pred)^2,
        bias = mean(errors)
    )
}

estimation_methods <- c(
    "Green Algorithms" = "estimated total energy (kJ) (GA)",
    "MLCO2 Calculator" = "estimated total energy (kJ) (MLCO2)",
    "STEP-P" = "estimated total energy (kJ) (STEP-P)",
    "STEP-E" = "estimated total energy (kJ) (STEP-E)",
    "PRE-P" = "PRE-P energy (kJ)",
    "PRE-E" = "PRE-E energy (kJ)",
    "PRE-P (measured duration)" = "PRE-P energy with measured duration (kJ)",
    "PRE-E (measured epochs)" = "PRE-E energy with measured epochs (kJ)"
)
t(sapply(estimation_methods, function(col) {
    estimation_metrics(energy_estimation_comparison$`true energy (kJ)`, energy_estimation_comparison[[col]])
}))
```

```{r plot-settings, echo=FALSE}
annotation_size <- 5.5 / ggplot2::.pt

# Common axis range for all panels
axis_max <- 1.05 * max(energy_estimation_comparison[c("true energy (kJ)", estimation_methods[1:6])])

identity_color <- "gray70"

baseline_color <- "black"
step_color <- "black"
pre_color <- "black"

point_color <- "black"
```

```{r plot-functions, echo=FALSE}
create_energy_plot <- function(
    data,
    true_col,
    pred_col,
    title,
    method_type = c("baseline", "step", "pre"),
    show_x = FALSE,
    show_y = FALSE
) {

    method_type <- match.arg(method_type)

    fit_linetype <- case_when(
        method_type == "baseline" ~ "dashed",
        method_type == "step" ~ "solid",
        method_type == "pre" ~ "dotdash"
    )

    fit_color <- case_when(
        method_type == "baseline" ~ baseline_color,
        method_type == "step" ~ step_color,
        method_type == "pre" ~ pre_color
    )

    fit_linewidth <- case_when(
        method_type == "baseline" ~ 0.9,
        method_type == "step" ~ 1.1,
        method_type == "pre" ~ 1.0
    )

    point_alpha <- case_when(
        method_type == "baseline" ~ 0.22,
        TRUE ~ 0.30
    )

    metrics <- estimation_metrics(data[[true_col]], data[[pred_col]])

    ggplot(
        data,
        aes(x = .data[[true_col]], y = .data[[pred_col]])
    ) +

        # points
        geom_point(
            alpha = point_alpha,
            size = 1.2,
            color = point_color
        ) +

        # ideal line
        geom_abline(
            slope = 1,
            intercept = 0,
            color = identity_color,
            linewidth = 0.5
        ) +

        # fitted regression
        geom_smooth(
            method = "lm",
            se = FALSE,
            color = fit_color,
            linewidth = fit_linewidth,
            linetype = fit_linetype
        ) +

        labs(
            title = title,
            x = if (show_x) "True energy (kJ)" else NULL,
            y = if (show_y) "Predicted energy (kJ)" else NULL
        ) +

        annotate(
            "text",
            x = 0.04 * axis_max,
            y = 0.96 * axis_max,
            hjust = 0,
            vjust = 1,
            label = sprintf("R² = %.3f\nbias = %.1f kJ", metrics[["R2"]], metrics[["bias"]]),
            size = annotation_size,
            color = "gray30"
        ) +

        coord_cartesian(
            xlim = c(0, axis_max),
            ylim = c(0, axis_max)
        ) +

        theme_classic(base_size = 10, base_family = "CMU Serif") +

        theme(
            panel.grid = element_blank(),

            plot.title = element_text(
                face = "bold",
                size = 9,
                hjust = 0.5
            ),

            axis.title = element_text(size = 9),

            axis.text = element_text(size = 8),

            plot.margin = margin(
                    t = 4,
                    r = 6,
                    b = 4,
                    l = 6
                ),

            aspect.ratio = 0.9
        )
}
```

```{r plot-energy-estimation-comparison}
ga_plot <- create_energy_plot(
    energy_estimation_comparison,
    "true energy (kJ)",
    "estimated total energy (kJ) (GA)",
    "Green Algorithms",
    "baseline",
    show_y = TRUE,
)

mlco2_plot <- create_energy_plot(
    energy_estimation_comparison,
    "true energy (kJ)",
    "estimated total energy (kJ) (MLCO2)",
    "MLCO2 Calculator",
    "baseline"
)

step_p_plot <- create_energy_plot(
    energy_estimation_comparison,
    "true energy (kJ)",
    "estimated total energy (kJ) (STEP-P)",
    "STEP-P",
    "step",
    show_y = TRUE
)

step_e_plot <- create_energy_plot(
    energy_estimation_comparison,
    "true energy (kJ)",
    "estimated total energy (kJ) (STEP-E)",
    "STEP-E",
    "step"
)

pre_p_plot <- create_energy_plot(
    energy_estimation_comparison,
    "true energy (kJ)",
    "PRE-P energy (kJ)",
    "PRE-P",
    "pre",
    show_x = TRUE,
    show_y = TRUE
)

pre_e_plot <- create_energy_plot(
    energy_estimation_comparison,
    "true energy (kJ)",
    "PRE-E energy (kJ)",
    "PRE-E",
    "pre",
    show_x = TRUE
)
```


```{r combine-energy-estimation-plots, echo=FALSE}
combined_energy_estimation_plot <-

    (
        ga_plot +
        mlco2_plot
    ) /

    (
        step_p_plot +
        step_e_plot
    ) /

    (
        pre_p_plot +
        pre_e_plot
    ) +

    plot_layout(
        axes = "collect"
    )
```
